note: Grids are in quart (4-block) units: cell (i, j) is getMainBiome(x0 + i*step, z0 + j*step), one palette character per cell; columns lists each key biome's [elevation in quarts, biome] layers (getNoiseBiome picks the nearest layer to quart y); noise holds [qx, qy, qz, getNoiseBiome]; zoom holds [x, y, z, Level#getBiome] (block coordinates, BiomeManager zoom).
